extension.description: Living state-machine documentation for Rust + Crux applications, beside the code.
command.show.title: Show State Machines
config.binary: Path to the crux-analyzer binary (default: resolved on PATH).
config.src: Directory with the Rust sources to analyze, relative to the workspace root. Empty tries shared/src, then src.
config.projectName: Project name shown in the panel. Empty uses the workspace folder name.
config.watch: Regenerate the model whenever a .rs file under the analyzed directory is saved.
